description: This Java source file defines the ProgressiveLoanRescheduleRequestDataValidator class, which implements validation logic for loan rescheduling requests within a financial application. It handles validation for creating and approving loan reschedule requests, ensuring parameters are correct, validating loan status, installment existence, and acceptance of specific rescheduling operations, with particular focus on progressive loan scenarios.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanRescheduleRequestDataValidator
classes.description: Implements validation logic for progressive loan rescheduling requests, ensuring correct parameters, loan statuses, and proper handling of interest rate, due date, and extra terms changes during create and approve actions.

methods.name: validateForCreateAction
methods.description: Validates the data for creating a loan reschedule request, checking supported parameters, required fields, and ensuring only one change operation is performed at a time.

methods.name: validateAdjustDueDateChange
methods.description: Validates conditions related to changing the loan's due date, including loan activity status and installment existence.

methods.name: validateInterestRate
methods.description: Validates interest rate modifications ensuring loan status allows such changes and associated installment exists.

methods.name: validateExtraTerms
methods.description: Validates the extra terms adjustments ensuring the loan is active.

methods.name: validateExtraTermsParam
methods.description: Extracts and validates the extra terms parameter from input JSON, ensuring it does not exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: validateUnsupportedParams
methods.description: Checks for unsupported parameters that should not be present during certain operations.

methods.name: validateForApproveAction
methods.description: Validates the data for approving a loan reschedule request, including checking related installments and status constraints.

methods.name: validateInterestRateChangeRescheduleFromDate
methods.description: Ensures that interest rate changes for specific dates do not already exist.

methods.name: validateInterestRateParam
methods.description: Validates the provided interest rate parameter, including min/max constraints based on the loan's product details.
